desc: Attractive, Accurate And Affordable, Say Hello To The Patriot Bantam. The Rifle That Raises The Bar On Standard Features And Is Designed To Fit Younger And Smaller Statured Users. FEATURES: Standard Patriot features include drop box magazines, recessed target crowns, fluted barrels, spiral fluted bolt with new streamlined bolt handle, Weaver scope bases, and patented LBA® user adjustable trigger system. Scoped models include a 3-9x40mm scope.
